claims.assertion: Anéeka says recent viral monoliths were human-made fakes, distinct from genuine monoliths; she says there are no genuine examples on Earth.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Her statement concerns examples on Earth.

claims.assertion: Anéeka describes genuine monoliths as dense, solid anti-portals, the closed counterpart to a portal opening; she says either may be crossed when it permits passage.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Yazhi says monoliths and portals are one natural phenomenon in universal reality; a rectangle is a lower-density interpretation of energy geometry.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
